title: Made-to-Order Reservations in Production: Cancellation and Deposit Settlement (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Console Action)
content:
**Policy.** When a customer cancels a Made-to-Order Reservation after its production has started, the cancellation is made on the customer's own in-person confirmation of the pending cancellation request for that reservation. Marlowe & Finch keeps a work charge from the deposit and refunds the rest of the deposit to the original card. That confirmation, the cancellation, the work charge kept and the refund of the rest of the deposit are booked together, the cancellation first.

**Where it applies.** The policy covers Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order Reservations whose production has started, that is, reservations showing status in production. The customer's request to cancel is recorded against the reservation as a cancellation request pending the customer's confirmation.

**What the records show afterwards**

| Record | After the customer's confirmation |
|---|---|
| Reservation | Status cancelled, dated today, for reason customer request |
| Cancellation request | Status confirmed |
| Reservation history | Two deposit entries: the work charge kept and the refund of the rest of the deposit to the card the deposit came from |

Both deposit entries are booked as amounts taken out of the deposit held. Together they bring the deposit held on the reservation to nothing.

---

### Console action: `confirm_made_to_order_cancellation_940e1e7b`

**Capability.** With this action the customer personally confirms the cancellation of their own Made-to-Order Reservation whose production has already started, and that confirmation settles its deposit. One call cancels the reservation at the customer's request, dated today. It books two deposit entries on the reservation, the work charge kept and the refund of the rest of the deposit, and it marks the customer's pending cancellation request as confirmed at the same time.

**How it is invoked.** The action belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks `confirm_made_to_order_cancellation_940e1e7b` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reservation_id` | The reservation number of the made-to-order pair being cancelled, as shown on the customer's reservation record | Reservation number, as returned by the reservation lookup |
| `reservation_request_id` | The request number of the customer's pending cancellation request for that pair | Request number, as returned by the reservation request lookup |
| `work_charge_usd` | The part of the deposit kept as the work charge; recorded on the history as a deposit entry taken out of the deposit | USD, non-negative, 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when nothing is kept |
| `deposit_refund_usd` | The part of the deposit refunded to the original card; recorded on the history as a deposit entry taken out of the deposit | USD, non-negative, 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when nothing is refunded |

**Return.** A successful call returns a confirmation with these fields:

- `reservation_id`
- `status`, always "cancelled"
- `cancelled_date`, today in YYYY-MM-DD form
- `cancel_reason`, always `customer_request`
- `reservation_request_id`
- `request_status`, always "confirmed"
- `work_charge_entry_id` and `work_charge_usd`, the amount-kept entry and its amount
- `refund_entry_id` and `deposit_refund_usd`, the refund entry and its amount

A returned status of "cancelled" means the cancellation and both entries were recorded.

**Illustration of a call (hypothetical values).** Reservation number R-1, request number Q-1, 120.00 kept, 60.00 refunded. The confirmation shows the reservation cancelled today for `customer_request`, the request confirmed, and two entry references with 120.00 and 60.00.
